rules.statement: In test code, when retry logic treats specific status codes or errors as retryable exceptions to a fail-fast rule, cover each exempted code with a test that checks the extra attempt and its wait.
rules.why: If one exempted code is dropped from the retry condition, the request would fail on the first attempt and the test suite would still pass.
rules.check: Compare the set of status codes or errors the retry helper treats as retryable (e.g. `-notin 408, 429`, 5xx) with the failures the retry tests inject; flag any exempted code no test sends.

rules.statement: In test code for retry or back-off logic, stub the sleep and random-jitter calls so tests assert the exact wait and never actually sleep.
rules.why: Stubbing the sleep and the random source makes the waits exact and checkable, and keeps the offline suite fast.
rules.check: Look for retry tests that call real `Start-Sleep`/`Task.Delay` or unstubbed `Get-Random`/`Random`, or that never assert the computed delay, including the Retry-After and cap cases.
